sloka: मूलं ह्येष मनुष्याणाम् धर्मसारो महाद्युतिः ।पुष्पम् फलम् च पत्रम् च शाखाश्चा स्येतरे जनाः ॥२-३३-१५॥
transliteration: mūlaṁ hyeṣa manuṣyāṇām dharmasāro mahādyutiḥ ।puṣpam phalam ca patram ca śākhāścā syetare janāḥ ॥2-33-15॥

translations.english: Effulgent Rama personifies the essence of dharma. He is the root of (the tree of) humanity. The other people are connected with this tree like flowers, fruit, leaves and branches.
